svg.text: LEYLINES, the Line's room: Göbekli Tepe + THE LEY LINE, THE HEIGHT PLAN (a proposal)
north is up · one plot = 12 x 12 squares = 42 m · room site_prebuilt_gobekli_ow_line
the ring · level, a board fits
open top · level, a board fits
scrub, boulders and standing stones (the wall of the place)
open ground (a clearing, a field, a yard)
THE LEY LINE: a kerbed bed of light, dead straight and level. You cross it; you do not walk along it
- - a FOUND way up (a climb, a trunk, a ladder)
┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.

Plot lines by district: G = Göbekli Tepe (left as built) · Y = The Ley Line. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots = the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height. A PROPOSAL: nothing is built from it until mondo says so.
